name: Citi / AAdvantage Globe Mastercard
rewardValuationDescription: American Airlines AAdvantage value varies by itinerary and redemption path; this app uses an estimated 1.30 cents per mile for annual-fee progress while displaying earned miles separately.
rewardRuleNotes: Issuer merchant coding and current product terms control whether a purchase qualifies for the listed bonus category.
Launched 2025-10-19 (Citigroup / American Airlines release; annual fee $350). Rides and Rails covers eligible taxis, rideshares and public transit.
Former Barclays AAdvantage Aviator Silver accounts were converted to this card on 2026-04-24; their grandfathered Barclays perks ended 2026-10-25.

cashbackCategories.category: Rides and Rails (rideshare, taxis and transit)

benefits.name: Turo Credit
benefits.description: Up to $30 back per eligible completed Turo trip paid with the card (card linked to the Turo account), up to $240 per calendar year.

benefits.name: Inflight Purchase Credit
benefits.description: Up to $100 in statement credits each calendar year on inflight purchases on American Airlines flights.

benefits.name: Annual Splurge Credit
benefits.description: Up to $100 in statement credits each calendar year on up to 2 of: AAdvantage Hotels bookings, 1stDibs, Future Personal Training and Live Nation (exclusions apply).

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck Credit
benefits.description: Up to $120 statement credit for the Global Entry or TSA PreCheck application fee, once every 4 years.

benefits.name: Admirals Club Globe Passes
benefits.description: 4 Admirals Club Globe Passes (24-hour access each) every calendar year, stored in the AAdvantage wallet.

benefits.name: American Airlines Companion Certificate
benefits.description: From the second cardmembership year, after renewal: one round-trip domestic Main Cabin companion ticket for a $99 ticketing fee plus taxes and fees. No spend requirement.

benefits.name: First Checked Bag Free
benefits.description: First checked bag free on domestic American Airlines itineraries for the cardholder and up to 8 companions on the same reservation.

benefits.name: Preferred Boarding
benefits.description: Preferred boarding on American Airlines flights for the cardholder and up to 8 companions on the same reservation.

benefits.name: Flight Streak Loyalty Points Bonus
benefits.description: 5,000 bonus Loyalty Points after every 4 qualifying American Airlines flights, up to 15,000 per status qualification year.

benefits.name: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on purchases.
